$description: Figure (library wave 3, component): the media and its caption, below it or on a band over the picture, with the credit.

figure-gap.$description: The space between the media and the caption under it.

figure-caption-text.$description: The caption: the secondary text color.

figure-caption-font-size.$description: The caption: the secondary size of the type scale.

figure-caption-line-height.$description: The caption's line height, for a sentence that wraps.

figure-caption-gap.$description: The space between the caption and the credit line.

figure-caption-max-width.$description: A caption under wide media keeps a readable line length.

figure-credit-text.$description: The credit or data source line.

figure-credit-font-size.$description: The credit line: the caption size of the type scale.

figure-overlay-background.$description: captionPosition="overlay": the solid media band behind the caption, over the picture's bottom edge.

figure-overlay-text.$description: captionPosition="overlay": the caption on the media band.

figure-overlay-padding-block.$description: captionPosition="overlay": the band's padding above and below the caption.

figure-overlay-padding-inline.$description: captionPosition="overlay": the band's padding at its sides.
